about: Literature-review probe for plan W5.12: 5 short papers (page texts, English and Hebrew) written for this repository, each with its question, method, sample, findings and limitations, the page each is on, and a phrase from it. Development numbers only; the acceptance set is 20 real papers (owner). CC0-1.0.

pages.text:
Sleep and memory in adolescents
Abstract
The aim of this study was to test whether one week of shortened sleep impairs memory consolidation in adolescents.
Introduction
Sleep supports the stabilisation of new memories.

Methods
We conducted a randomized crossover trial with two sleep conditions of seven nights each.
Participants
A total of 64 adolescents aged 15 to 18 were recruited from three high schools.
Memory was assessed with a paired-associates task.

Results
After the restricted week, participants recalled 18 percent fewer word pairs than after the control week.
Discussion
A limitation of this study is that sleep was measured with actigraphy rather than polysomnography.

question.phrase: test whether one week of shortened sleep impairs memory consolidation

limitations.phrase: sleep was measured with actigraphy rather than polysomnography

pages.text:
Remote work and productivity: a field experiment
We ask whether working from home changes the productivity of call-centre employees.

Design
The study used a randomized field experiment over nine months in a travel agency.
Sample
The sample consisted of 249 employees who volunteered, of whom 131 were assigned to work from home.

Findings
Home workers completed 13 percent more calls per shift and quit at half the rate of the office group.
Limitations
Our results may not generalize to jobs that require close teamwork.

question.phrase: whether working from home changes the productivity of call-centre employees

method.phrase: randomized field experiment over nine months

findings.phrase: completed 13 percent more calls per shift

limitations.phrase: may not generalize to jobs that require close teamwork

pages.text:
Microplastics in freshwater fish
The purpose of this study was to measure how microplastic ingestion affects gut health and growth in zebrafish.

Materials and methods
Fish were exposed in the laboratory to polystyrene particles for four weeks, and tissues were examined by histology.
A total of 120 zebrafish were divided into four exposure groups.

Results
Exposed fish showed gut inflammation and grew 12 percent less than controls.
Limitations and future work
Laboratory concentrations were higher than those found in most rivers.

pages.text:
שימוש ברשתות חברתיות וחרדה בקרב בני נוער
מטרת המחקר הייתה לבדוק אם שימוש יומי ממושך ברשתות חברתיות קשור לתסמיני חרדה בקרב בני נוער.

שיטה
נערך סקר אורך בשני גלים בהפרש של שנה.
משתתפים
במדגם השתתפו 1,200 תלמידים בכיתות ט' עד י"ב מעשרים בתי ספר.

ממצאים
נמצא כי תלמידים שהשתמשו ברשתות יותר משלוש שעות ביום דיווחו על פי שניים תסמיני חרדה.
מגבלות
הנתונים מבוססים על דיווח עצמי ואינם מאפשרים להסיק סיבתיות.

pages.text:
Exercise and depressive symptoms: a meta-analysis
Our objective was to estimate the effect of aerobic exercise on depressive symptoms in adults.

Methods
We performed a systematic review and random-effects meta-analysis of randomized trials published up to 2025.
Forty-one trials with 2,890 adult participants met the inclusion criteria.

Results
Aerobic exercise three times a week reduced depressive symptoms with a standardized mean difference of 0.56.
Limitations
Most trials were small and could not blind participants to the intervention.

question.phrase: estimate the effect of aerobic exercise on depressive symptoms in adults

method.phrase: systematic review and random-effects meta-analysis of randomized trials

findings.phrase: reduced depressive symptoms with a standardized mean difference of 0.56

limitations.phrase: Most trials were small and could not blind participants
